# Alternatives workbench · S07

One collection, three entry points: generate options, respond to concerns, reconcile proposals. All lead into the same comparison of mechanisms, benefits, costs, assumptions and evidence, followed by a decision and test. Compare up to four at once; keep up to eighteen alternatives. There is no computed ranking.

Drag a concern onto a route to create an alternative or onto a card to connect it. Carry a position’s benefit into an alternative, or borrow another alternative’s benefit as a snapshot. Every drag has a labelled button path. Connections state an intention, not proof. Changed sources request review without erasing prior reasoning. Branches freeze the parent’s reasoning and context and record why the branch was made.

The existing Objections storage key and exports still open. Legacy work is upgraded in place without dropping original fields. Three Answers and Disagreement workspaces can be copied from browser storage or imported from JSON; both preserve the original source in their own tool and as an unchanged snapshot in the copy. The original routes remain usable in the archive. Imported work always becomes a new workspace. Borrowed strengths, criteria, selected alternatives, protected intentions, boundaries, costs and tests all survive.

Creative-kit supplies local saving, recovery, grouped Undo and Markdown/editable JSON export. Its optional import parser hook is used only here; other tools retain their original parser. Source snapshots, branch reasons and all alternatives travel with exports. Comparison membership is independent of selecting a test. Copying a design’s test into the working plan is explicit and undoable.

`consolidation.test.js` covers legacy formats, field preservation, source independence, stale connections, atomic failures, comparison limits, Undo and portable round trips. Browser delivery evidence is in `docs/ROADMAP-DELIVERY.md`.
